These findings come from Jackson copies shaded inside com.hazelcast:hazelcast 5.7.0. Hazelcast 5.7.0 is the latest published Hazelcast release; no available 5.x release bundles the fixed Jackson versions, and shaded classes cannot be replaced with a Gradle dependency override. Tracking Hazelcast for a release that embeds fixed Jackson.

The jackson-databind instances used by neo4j have been bumped to a fixed version. The remaining jackson-databind is shaded and relocated inside parquet-jackson JARs. parquet-jackson only deserializes its own fixed-schema metadata POJOs, which do not rely on @JsonView/@JsonIgnoreProperties filtering, so the property-filtering bypass is not reachable.
